title: Rapid stabilization of general linear systems with F-equivalence
summary: We study the rapid stabilization of general linear systems, when the differential operator $\mathcal{A}$ has a Riesz basis of eigenvectors. We find simple sufficient conditions for the rapid stabilization and the construction of a relatively explicit feedback operator. We use an $F$-equivalence approach \textcolor{black}{relying on Fredholm transformation} to show a stronger result: under these sufficient conditions the system is equivalent to a simple exponentially stable system, with arbitrarily large decay rate.
